description: EU:RU is a modern remake of the classic 1.12.2 mod "Extra Utilities" for Forge by RWTema.

mods.name: Extra Utilities: Reutilized
mods.description: A remake of the old-but-gold 1.12.2 mod "Extra Utilities 2"

releases.notes:
**PRE-RELEASE!**
This version brings BIG updates, bug fixes, improvements and much, MUCH more!
This version is HEAVILY unfinished, and won't be fully released before all the current features are fleshed out and textures are done.

We're merging with Seth's Craftables! We will be slowly adding most (if not all) of the features from Seth's Craftables. All the blocks and items associated with Seth's Craftables are in a seperate "Seth's Craftables" Creative Tab

Added Builder's Wand (temporary texture)
Added Demonically Gargantuan Drum (temporary texture)
Added Klein Bottle (temporary-ish texture)
Added Demon Metal Ingot/Block (temporary-ish texture)
Added Energy & Fluid Trash Cans

Updated Trash Can and Trash Chest textures and models
Updated Creative Mill textures
Updated Frosty & Slimey Generator textures
Updated the capacities for the Drums

Fixed Machines & Generators having weird input/output behavior, especially with hoppers
Fixed weird Angel Ring behavior
Fixed a spelling error when using the Ring of the Flying Squid
Fixed issue with Chunk Loading Ward (again..)

Made it so you need a pickaxe to break the trash cans/chest

General improvements and bug fixes

cVer (config_version) has been updated to "973.3" (PRE.3 using numbers), so your config will regenerate when updating

mods.description: A remake of the old-but-gold 1.12.2 mod "Extra Utilities 2"

releases.notes:
Removed Chunk Loader Tester
Removed GridPower Scanner from the Creative GUI (still available through /give)

Updated Creative Energy Source Texture
Updated Ender Generator Texture
Updated Overclocked Generator Texture
Updated Disenchantment Generator Texture (+ animations!)
Updated Culinary Generator Texture
Updated Redstone Clock Texture (+ animations!)
Updated Evil Infused Block Texture
Updated Evil Infused Ingot Texture (+ animations!)
Updated Evil Infused Nugget Texture

Added Generator-specific backdrops for their respective GUIs

Reworked Overclocked Generator Recipe to better match its new textures
Reworked Redstone Clock Recipe to better match its new textures

Fixed JEI not showing the FE output of fuels in generators
Fixed Shady Merchant crash when you don't have any emeralds
Fixed Shady Merchant not trading properly
Fixed Drop of Evil not dropping from entities in the "drop_from" list from the config

Rearranged some items in the Creative GUI

General bug fixes and improvements

Updated cVer (config_version) to 2.9. Your config will regenerate when updating, so back up any custom settings first.

mods.name: Extra Utilities: Reutilized
mods.description: A remake of the old-but-gold 1.12.2 mod "Extra Utilities 2"

releases.notes:
Fixed a catastrophic bug where if you placed more than the efficiency cutoff of GP generators, they would all break and only generate 1GP per generator, no matter how much they were supposed to generate

Added Dragon Egg Mill (temporary texture)
Added Redstone Clock (temporary texture)
Added Shady Merchant (temporary texture | requires Lithostitched | still WIP, expect bugs)
Added a recipe for the Wind Mill
Added a recipe for the Wireless Battery
Added JEI compatibility for the Heating Resonator's recipe

Updated all recipes to use Item Tags where ever possible, to allow for much higher mod compatibility

Fixed the Creative Generator resetting it's output FE when you open it's GUI

General bug fixes and improvements

Changed cVer (config_version) to 2.8, so your config will regenerate when updating
